summaryJa: 報告書種別：Range Fouler Reporting Form（個人識別情報はSPEARで非表示）。報告日時：2020-10-15 14:18:39 Z、接触時間：14:18:39～14:19:52（約1分）。ミッション：ISR、昼間。接触数：1。位置情報：MGRS表記「400 8D 6�1�」（推定緯度/経度欄は不完全）。位置環境：アデン湾上空、報告機高度19,073 HAT。センサー情報：IRセンサーをブラックホットに設定、センサー視線は自機高度から-50度、斜距離4.06 NM、地上距離4.78 KM。対象の描写：IRで丸く「コールド」な物体、明るい白（ブラックホットで白く見える）、進行方向は文書表記「3,19 degrees」、速度20 mph、約1分間で数回の急方向変化あり。接触は移動中と記載。ファイル保存指示：表示テープを全期間リップして.wmvで保存、所定のリポジトリへアップロード。その他：フォーム保存および送信手順の注意（“紫のsubmitボタンは使わない”等）。
summaryEn: Form type: Range Fouler Reporting Form (identifying information sanitized by SPEAR). Report date/time: 15 Oct 2020, 14:18:39 Z. Contact duration: 14:18:39–14:19:52 (~1 minute). Mission: ISR, day. Number of contacts: 1. Location: MGRS entry shown as "400 8D 6�1�" (estimated lat/long field incomplete). Area: over the Gulf of Aden; reporting aircraft at 19,073 HAT. Sensor details: IR sensor set to black hot; sensor aimed -50° from own altitude; slant range 4.06 NM; ground range 4.78 KM. Contact description: round, cold in IR, appeared bright white on black-hot setting; course listed as "3,19 degrees" in the report; speed 20 mph; made several abrupt directional changes during the ~1-minute contact. Contact recorded as moving. File handling: ensure display tapes are ripped for entire interaction and saved as .wmv and uploaded to the specified repository. Additional administrative note: instructions on saving and emailing the form (do not use the purple submit button).
